instruction: Candid full shot from a low angle in an indoor martial arts gym. On the right, the man in the blue sleeveless shirt (R1) leans back, striking with his right knee. On the left, the bearded man in the maroon t-shirt (R2) has his back partially turned while clinching the opponent. In the background, blurred gym members are visible. Bright overhead lighting casts soft shadows on the gray mats.
elements: R1 is the knee striker, leaning back and striking with his right knee
R2 is the clinching opponent, with his back partially turned
R2 clinches R1 while R1 delivers the knee strike
R1 and R2 are interacting in a martial arts sparring/fighting configuration
gray gym mats under the fighters

questions.q: Is R1 the one leaning back and striking with his right knee, rather than R2 doing the knee strike?
Is R2 the one clinching the opponent while R1 delivers the knee strike, rather than R1 being the clincher and R2 being the knee striker?
Is R2 the one with his back partially turned during the clinch, rather than R1 being described with his back partially turned?
questions.element: R2 has his back partially turned

questions.q: Are R1 and R2 posed as martial arts opponents, with R1 attacking by knee strike and R2 engaged in a clinch?
questions.element: R1 and R2 have distinct fighting roles
